steps.do: For each personal savings account, check that the deposit meets both its opening deposit and its ongoing minimum balance. For each account that passes, add three numbers: (a) the base APY, (b) the single highest linked-checking boost from a checking account the customer is age-eligible for (pairs listed in doc 012; boost values are on each checking account's page), and (c) the single highest credit-card bonus from that savings account's card table, counting only cards the customer can get. The Diamond Elite Card is invitation-only, and the Gold Rewards Card needs Rho-Bank+. Choose the combination with the highest total APY. If two cards are close, compare bonus × balance minus annual fee. Recommend one checking, one savings and one card, and give the APY math.
steps.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

steps.do: Explain the order of the work. A new savings account needs an active checking account that has been open at least 14 days. So the customer's existing checking account must stay open until the savings account is opened. Open the savings account first, then the new checking account, and close the old checking account last.

steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.
